name: Large Language Model
definition: An artificial intelligence model trained on vast amounts of text data, capable of understanding, generating, and processing human-like text.

name: Knowledge Graph Construction
definition: The process of automatically or semi-automatically building a structured knowledge graph from various data sources, often unstructured text.

name: Natural Language
definition: The language spoken or written by humans, as opposed to formal or artificial languages, which is the subject of study in natural language processing.

name: Knowledge Graph
definition: A structured representation of knowledge that stores information in a graph format, consisting of entities (nodes) and their relationships (edges).

name: Hallucination
definition: In the context of Large Language Models, hallucination refers to the generation of plausible but factually incorrect or unsupported information.

name: GraphJudge
definition: A proposed framework for knowledge graph construction that aims to enhance quality by eliminating noise and addressing inaccuracies and hallucination using a fine-tuned large language model.

name: Entity-Centric Strategy
definition: A strategy or approach that focuses on individual entities (e.g., persons, organizations, locations) as the primary units for processing or analysis, often used to filter noise in information extraction.

name: Text-Graph Pair Dataset
definition: A dataset comprising pairs of text documents and corresponding knowledge graphs, used for training and evaluating models in knowledge graph construction tasks.

name: GraphRAG System
definition: A system that integrates knowledge graphs with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques, often leveraging graph structures to enhance information retrieval for generative models.

name: Recommendation System
definition: A software system that suggests relevant items or information to users based on their preferences, past behavior, or other contextual data.

name: Natural Language Processing
definition: A subfield of artificial intelligence that focuses on enabling computers to understand, interpret, and generate human language.

name: Text Generation
definition: The task in natural language processing where a model produces human-like text based on a given prompt or input.
